body: This session finished the Android accessibility work and handed macOS testing to a fresh session.U+000AU+000ATo-do tap-area overlap:U+000AU+002D Specced with the interphase bug pathway (docs/specs/todo-tap-overlap.md). The owner chose "share the line", with the sweep's size rule measuring the area a tap can reach.U+000AU+002D Built by mitosis as PRs #210 (sweep: reachable-size rule in the widget sweep and the phone tool, with 8 accepted to-do baseline lines) and #211 (renderer: to-do screen-reader areas split halfway, cut to the note, tried first).U+000AU+002D Code review fixes were applied: exact halfway split, an ordering test, grandparent cases.U+000AU+002D Full suite green on both branches (3,112 and 3,117 tests), analyze clean, 30 goldens pass. The owner merged both.U+000AU+000APhone verification of #208 to #211 on the Galaxy Note 10+, 2026-09-26:U+000AU+002D Plain profile APK from d36b748, with 51 screens re-captured into ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/android/a11y-verify/.U+000AU+002D The merged phone tool reports 494 findings before and 44 after. All 44 are explained: 17 dismiss barriers, 6 Flutter text-menu items, 12 accepted to-do lines and 9 others.U+000AU+002D Confirmed on the phone:U+000A  U+002D to-do areas meet and sit inside the note;U+000A  U+002D finger tick and untick work, including in the old overlap zone;U+000A  U+002D the hidden pill no longer swallows taps, and the revealed pill starts at its painted top;U+000A  U+002D the video scrubber is disabled until it can seek;U+000A  U+002D finger text selection works;U+000A  U+002D items read once;U+000A  U+002D controls are 48 dp.U+000AU+002D One regression from #209: the month picker's accessibility tree is empty on the phone. The cause is pinned to its BlockSemantics wrapper by a probe APK; the mechanism is unexplained.U+000AU+002D Four smaller problems and two painted shifts remain. All are recorded as risks on c2, for later.U+000AU+002D Also: blind spot 2 in the sweep report was corrected to "clip artifact", and task chip task_e34a20a1 was reissued with the phone overlap figures.U+000AU+000APhone state: today's mood (2026-09-26) is set to Calm. Every other test edit was restored, and the phone runs the merged build d36b748.U+000AU+000AOwner's go-ahead for macOS, 2026-09-27, quoted verbatim: "In the FRESH session, I want to e2e test the live Desktop version of Field Notes similar to the Android testing above.
